title: LogEntry
description: A single normalized application log line.

id.description: Unique identifier for this log entry (UUID).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the log event.

service.description: Name of the service/module that emitted the log.

thread_or_request_id.description: Thread name, request ID, or trace ID for correlating related logs.

source_file.description: Source file that emitted the log, if determinable.

metadata.description: Arbitrary structured key/value fields extracted from structured logs (e.g., JSON logs).

raw.description: The original unparsed log line, preserved for traceability.
